expecting.set_up_sleep_space: Set up a cot or bassinet for the baby
expecting.fit_car_seat: Have the baby capsule or car seat fitted
expecting.assemble_stroller: Put the pram together and practise folding it
expecting.wash_baby_clothes: Wash the baby's first clothes and bedding
expecting.set_up_changing_station: Set up a nappy-changing area and stock it
expecting.set_up_feeding_supplies: Get feeding supplies ready, such as bottles, burp cloths and a feeding pillow
expecting.stock_household_basics: Stock up on toilet paper, cleaning supplies and other basics
expecting.freeze_easy_meals: Cook and freeze some easy meals
expecting.arrange_pet_care: Arrange who looks after pets during the birth
expecting.line_up_helpers: Ask family and friends who can help in the first weeks, and when
expecting.pack_parent_bag: Pack a bag for the birthing parent with clothes, nightwear and toiletries
expecting.pack_partner_bag: Pack a bag for the birth partner with snacks and a change of clothes
expecting.pack_baby_things: Pack the baby's things: outfits, nappies, a hat and a wrap
expecting.pack_going_home_outfit: Pick a going-home outfit for the baby
expecting.pack_chargers: Pack phone chargers and a long cable
expecting.pack_comfort_items: Pack comfort items, such as a pillow, slippers and a playlist
expecting.pack_pregnancy_records: Pack your Medicare card and your pregnancy health record
expecting.pack_birth_preferences: Pack a copy of your birth preferences, if you've written them
expecting.plan_route: Plan your route to where you're giving birth, and where to park
expecting.bags_by_door: Put the bags by the door or in the car
expecting.plan_parental_leave: Tell your employers your parental leave plans, and check what leave you can take
expecting.check_leave_pay: Check whether you can get Parental Leave Pay from Services Australia, and apply
expecting.choose_baby_doctor: Choose a GP for the baby's check-ups
expecting.preregister_birth_place: Fill in your hospital or birth centre's admission forms
expecting.check_insurance_for_baby: Find out how to add the baby to your private insurance policy, if you have one
expecting.research_childcare: Research childcare centres and any waiting lists
expecting.update_wills: Make or update your wills, and choose a guardian for the baby
expecting.plan_leave_budget: Plan a household budget for while you are on leave

newborn.register_birth: Register the birth with your state or territory's registry
newborn.claim_family_payments: Claim Family Tax Benefit through myGov
newborn.add_baby_to_insurance: Add the baby to your private insurance policy, if you have one
newborn.book_first_checkup: Book the baby's first check with your child and family health nurse or GP
newborn.keep_health_record_handy: Keep the baby's health record book somewhere easy to find
newborn.book_parent_checkup: Book the birthing parent's postnatal check-up, as your provider advises
newborn.update_employers: Tell your employers the baby has arrived, and confirm your leave dates
newborn.agree_visitors: Agree when visitors are welcome, and let family know
newborn.ask_for_help: Ask family and friends to bring meals or run errands
newborn.apply_for_passport: Apply for the baby's passport, if you plan to travel
newborn.split_night_shifts: Agree how you'll split nights and early mornings
newborn.split_household_chores: Split the household chores between you
newborn.plan_easy_meals: Plan easy meals for the week
newborn.set_up_grocery_delivery: Set up grocery delivery or click and collect
newborn.restock_diapers: Add nappies and wipes to the shopping list each week
newborn.set_up_feeding_spot: Set up a feeding spot with water, snacks and a phone charger
newborn.bottle_cleaning_spot: Set up a spot and a routine for cleaning bottles
newborn.laundry_routine: Pick a laundry routine for baby clothes and bedding
newborn.pack_outing_bag: Pack a nappy bag that stays ready by the door
newborn.save_health_contacts: Save your GP and the Pregnancy, Birth and Baby helpline numbers in both phones
newborn.plan_rest_time: Plan time for each of you to rest or get out of the house
newborn.shared_photo_album: Set up a shared photo album for family
